narrative.overview:
Reogent's interface is a precision instrument where every surface is permanently shaped — dimensioned at rest, but barely. Shadows function at whisper intensity: tiny offsets, minimal blur, near-transparent opacity. You feel what is pressable, what is a well, what is content, but the depth registers subconsciously rather than announcing itself.

The system reads as one continuous material shaped into different forms for different functions: raised for actions, recessed for input, flat for content. No decoration, no illustration, no ornament. Quality lives in restraint: the lightest possible shadow that still communicates depth.

The landing page breaks this discipline intentionally — larger type (4xl-6xl), spring physics, blur reveals, scroll-driven parallax — creating contrast between marketing energy and in-app calm. This is a designed boundary, not inconsistency.
keyCharacteristics: Whisper-level dimension on every surface — felt, not seen
Precision and consistency as the aesthetic itself
Muted indigo accent, used sparingly, always meaning interactive
Content-forward: neumorphic frame never competes with chat or map data
Landing page permitted to be expressive; in-app is disciplined

rules.name: The Muted-for-AA Rule
rules.body: All subdued text uses --muted (#5a6066). Never --outline or --outline-variant for text — they fail WCAG AA on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Indigo Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo appears only on interactive elements and active states. Never for decorative purposes, background fills, or large surfaces. Its presence always means actionable or current.

rules.name: The Opacity Layering Rule
rules.body: Use fractional opacity modifiers (/15, /40, /60) to create tinted surfaces that remain translucent. Solid token colors for text and borders; opacity modifiers for background tints and state indicators.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Emphasis uses weight 500–550. Bold (700+) never appears. Maximum weight is 600 for markdown strong, table headers, and list markers.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Structured identifiers (course codes, times, building codes, distances, amounts) render in Commit Mono. Data has a different texture than prose.

rules.name: The 14px-Base Rule
rules.body: Body text is 0.875rem (14px). This is an information-dense tool, not a reading experience. Tighter base allows more content visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The Landing Exception Rule
rules.body: The landing page uses text-4xl through text-6xl, custom line-heights (1.05), tighter tracking (-0.035em), and spring physics. These values are exclusive to the marketing surface.

rules.name: The Dual-Tier Rule
rules.body: Tier 1 (Tailwind shadow-* utilities) for one-off depth. Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) for composed surfaces. Never mix on the same element.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: Light source is always upper-left. Every shadow falls bottom-right, every highlight top-left. Consistent across both tiers.

rules.name: The Whisper-Dimension Rule
rules.body: Neumorphic surfaces have depth at rest, but at minimal intensity (4-6% opacity shadows). Depth is felt rather than seen. Hover/active modify the recipe.

dos: Do apply .neu-panel / .neu-raised / .neu-inset for composed surfaces — they carry the unified shadow recipe.
Do use --muted (#5a6066) for all subdued text. Never --outline or --outline-variant for text.
Do use --neu-ease (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all in-app layout animations at 150-350ms.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — all animations collapse to 0.01ms, reveals show immediately.
Do use [data-theme="dark"] for theme switching — never prefers-color-scheme media query.
Do maintain whisper-level dimension on all surfaces at all times.
Do use asymmetric bubble radii to indicate message direction.
Do use opacity modifiers on color tokens for tinted backgrounds.
Do enforce 44px minimum touch targets on mobile.
Do use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for bottom-pinned elements.
donts: Don't mix Tier 1 (shadow-* utilities) and Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) on the same element.
Don't add border to .neu-panel or .neu-raised elements. Exception: .neu-button has 1px border-subtle.
Don't use pure black in any shadow — warm gray in light mode, deep neutral in dark mode only.
Don't apply backdrop-filter outside .glass-neu. Glass is for overlays, never decorative.
Don't animate shadow values directly — animate transform and switch classes via state.
Don't apply neumorphic depth to text content — depth frames containers, content stays flat.
Don't use font-weight 700+ anywhere. Maximum is 600.
Don't use primary indigo for backgrounds, decoration, or large surfaces. It means interactive only.
Don't use spring physics or blur reveals in the app shell. Those belong to the landing page only.
Don't create new shadow recipes. Use --neu-surface-shadow or --neu-inset-shadow, or the five Tier 1 utilities.
